evidence.detail: Exact v308 constructs a JButton labelled Clone with the clone.png asset.
The button tooltip states that it takes the items currently equipped in game and sets them as the current active loadout.
The factory accepts rs/gui/b/h and installs rs/gui/b/a/b as the action listener; rs/gui/b/h directly obtains this button while building the loadout UI.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 titles the JFrame "Set <skill> level" and maps indices to Attack, Range, Strength, Prayer, Defence, Magic and Hitpoints.
The editor parses the entered level, clamps it to 1..99, writes the selected slot of the active loadout stat array, refreshes the loadout UI and closes.
The frame is instantiated from the loadout GUI with its active loadout model and clicked skill index.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 is a JFrame used with titles/actions such as "Name Your Loadout"/Create and Rename from the loadout GUI.
The frame exposes a loadout-name text field plus Color and Icon selectors, including a None (Default) icon choice and named colors.
Create and rename callers read the frame's name, selected color and selected loadout icon back into rs/gui/b/a loadout records.
